sam: Handoff FYI — I'm on until 02:00 UTC. Quick watchlist for tonight:
- intermittent kv-prefetch-rate alerts in eu-west; noisy but nonblocking
- decoder_pool tail latency spikes for long sequences (>1200 tokens) occasionally
- ephemeral TTL drift on prefix cache; miss spikes ~45m after deploy

marta: noted. any immediate mitigations we should do? :thinking_face:

sam: For now: 1) throttle prefetch to 0.6 for eu-west via infra toggle 2) bump alert to 10m rolling avg (query below) 3) short PR to soften autoscaler aggressiveness is open

sam: Alert query (use for testing/muting):
```
sum(rate(kv_prefetch_requests_total[5m])) by (node)
```

sam: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/infer/pulls/832 (low-risk tweak to scale-down thresholds)

jia: I'll cover 02:00-06:00 follow-up. I'll mute the noisy rule in alertmanager for eu-west for the night if it keeps flapping :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: deploy job #8942 started on eu-west (triggered by sam)

sam: If you see decoder tail > 500ms for 3 samples run: `scripts/drain_node.sh <node>` and ping me.

marta: can you paste the exact prefetch toggle command?

sam: `curl -XPOST https://infra.internal/api/toggles/prefetch -d '{"region":"eu-west","value":0.6}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}'`

marta: done, toggled. watching dashboards (prefetch queue length + kv miss rate). annotating timeline. :white_check_mark:

jia: I added a small repro for TTL drift locally, opened PR 834 to add a guard in the eviction path. Will monitor CI results.

sam: No customer-impact observed so far. Leaving this on the handoff notes for tomorrow's rotation. /cc @eng-oncall

marta: copying to handoff doc: https://company.docs/handoffs/2026-03-18-eu-prefetch-observations

sam: Thanks all — ping me if anything escalates.
